title: Data centers could erase decades of air quality gains
hook_before: A rush of new data centers could bring air pollution roaring back in Texas.
script:
Ninety percent more pollution could hit Texas from data centers.
These facilities are demanding a tremendous amount of electricity.
Generative AI expansion is driving the physical infrastructure behind this boom.
Pollution levels could return to numbers not seen since the two thousands.
Utilities and developers must decide how to meet this power demand cleanly.
Will your local utility turn to gas to power data centers?
